#34909 (+55 / -3)

Like in #PR reviews > #34554 calculate divisors using prime factorization, this PR has been delegated to others, so it is off the queue and I can't do anything about it. Can I please ask that we either stop that practice, or keep such PRs on the queue? Or perhaps automatically remove the delegation after a few days?
This PR is from 3 months ago and is now stuck in limbo, which is frustrating.
(to be clear, I think it's perfectly reasonable for people to be busy or not notice PRs which were borsed to them, which is why I think removing the delegation is a good idea, so that others can be assigned)
Thanks!

This PR proves that the docs#Sym2.fromRel set of a symmetric relation r is equivalent to summing that set restricted to fibers of a function f, given that f agrees on elements related by r. It also adds a useful recursor for members of docs#Sym2.fromRel.

I think a lot of us just have too many github notifications for pings / assignments there to reach us, so in cases like these, I think pinging on zulip is appropriate.

cc: @Bhavik Mehta @Kyle Miller @Eric Wieser

I'll try to look into changing how delegation works with the queue, but it'll probably be at least a week or so before I can get to it.
Hey, this is still off the queue, can you de-delegate please?
